verdict.rationale: Decagon documents Simulations, an integrated testing suite for validating agent behavior across channels before production and after each update [decagon-docs-29]. Duet can also generate tests that check whether the agent responds accurately, follows policies and stays on brand [decagon-docs-11]. Together these cover the simulated-conversation side of the story. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of replaying historical tickets as test cases (past interactions are only shown feeding AOP generation), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the Simulations suite.
